title: 中金Kevin Lou：低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
speaker: Kevin Lou

segments.en: Do they look attractive enough, yet, at least on the fundamentals basis?
segments.zh: 它们现在看起来足够有吸引力吗？至少从基本面看。

segments.en: Well, here's the scene, the dilemma is, you know, there are low invariations, I agree. But low invariations sometimes could mean value trap.
segments.zh: 困境在于，估值确实低，但低估值有时可能意味着价值陷阱。

segments.en: And the last thing you don't want to have is the opportunity cost. So we may still see too much downside risk from this level of evaluation.
segments.zh: 最不想看到的是机会成本。从这个估值水平看，下行风险仍然很大。

segments.en: I call it a high pay off ratio, but relatively low wind ratio. So it's not probably suitable for investors to have very high requirements to the benchmark or very tight funding cost.
segments.zh: 我称之为高赔率但低胜率。因此可能不适合对基准要求很高或资金成本很紧的参与者。

segments.en: At this level, for those long-term investors, it's not the bad deal, but in order for the HSEI and tech, all the general consumption to catch up the rally notably, it better to first have the USU to come down and then, more importantly, to have the policy to pivot to consumption.
segments.zh: 对于长期参与者来说，这个水平不算差，但要让恒生科技和消费板块显著反弹，最好先让美国利率下降，更重要的是政策转向消费。

segments.en: You know, there are some arguments saying that it's better to have technology to pull back so that we can rotate to the traditional part. I think that kind of thinking is probably misplaced, because the traditional part is weak, is not just because it's weak valuation, it's because it's weak fundamentals, and the correction of the technology won't automatically translate into the improvement of the fundamentals.
segments.zh: 有人认为让科技回调以便轮动到传统板块更好。我认为这种想法可能错了，因为传统板块疲弱不仅是估值低，更是基本面差，科技回调不会自动改善基本面。
